name: Undertow

sections.name: Undertow: Low water
sections.why: The bass alone, long notes on the and, A minor 9 to E minor 9.

sections.name: Undertow: Pulse
sections.why: The kick on one and three; the bass starts walking your line.

sections.name: Undertow: Surface
sections.why: Snap 9's groove: the bass gone, the wood and the marimba on top.

notes.name: Your off-beat line, halved, half time

rhythm.name: Your off-beat line, halved, half time

sections.name: Undertow: Under again
sections.why: The bass back in half time: your line's first bar, twice as slow.

sections.name: Undertow: Ebb
sections.why: No kick: the bass played loose, the hands and the marimba.

sections.name: Undertow: Still
sections.why: Long bass notes and the air.

why: The bass leads from the start and leaves for the peak: the peak is Snap 9's groove, the minimal, bass-less one you liked, on its own pedal. Then the bass comes back in half time and is the last thing left.
